title: Content Vienna 2026 - Competition For Digital Design
description: Vienna-based creators submit in-development digital projects for €10,000 production grants in this free competition.
descriptionDetailed: Content Vienna is a free competition for digital design run by the Vienna Business Agency. Five projects receive €10,000 production grants each, plus a €10,000 special prize for Digital Design for Health and a €1,000 bonus for awarded projects led by women. Eligible fields include games, XR, animation, AI, and interactive formats.

prize.description: Five creative digital projects receive production grants of €10,000 each, and one project receives the €10,000 special prize for Digital Design for Health, awarded in cooperation with the Open Innovation in Science Center of the Ludwig Boltzmann Gesellschaft. Awarded projects led by women receive a €1,000 bonus, and up to five further projects receive the Content Vienna Connecting prize, including a travel allowance of €1,500 and participation at South by Southwest.

audience.eligibilityLabel: For digital creators and companies based in Vienna
audience.eligibilityDetail: Open to developers, studios, startups, companies, private individuals, and associations implementing creative digital projects. Applicants must have a residential, company, or business address in Vienna, or the project must be predominantly developed or produced in Vienna, or Vienna must be a significant thematic or creative reference point. Each applicant or company may submit only one project.
